title: Spielberg's EA game 'LMNO' about a woman with alien empathy powers

tellings.quote: >> The game was codenamed LM O, and it was about a woman who is human but has alien capabilities running around using the power of empathy uh to disarm people because the government is chasing her.

plain: Around 2004, Steven Spielberg was working with Electronic Arts, the video game company in Los Angeles, on a game codenamed "LMNO" about a human woman with alien powers who escapes a government that is chasing her by using empathy to disarm people. A writer named Brent Friedman, who says he was there, tells Michels about it first-hand. It is told as one more sign of how often Spielberg returned to aliens and government secrecy in his work.
